attestation.for_use: Litigation exhibit, Daubert support, regulatory submission, retailer compliance review.
attestation.what_this_is: A point-in-time defense package for a single Heavy Metal Index product-category page: the page as published (git-pinned and hashed), every literature source the routing layer maps to it (each git-pinned and hashed), the regulatory caps the page declares, and a claim-by-claim provenance summary.
attestation.verifiable_by: Any party can clone https://github.com/paleofoundation/heavymetalindex at each named commit, hash the body of each named page, and confirm the content_sha256 values below. The contributing-source set is reproducible from data/evidence/product_source_routing_audit.csv at the same commit.
attestation.not_a_certification: This dossier pins and traces the Heavy Metal Index's published literature evidence. It does not state, endorse, or warrant an HMTc certification threshold or a pass/fail determination. Certification thresholds are policy choices that live in the HMTc program (heavymetaltested.com), not in this evidence base. See /methodology and the wiki/HMTc separation described there.
